**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement imposes no exclusivity on Clear Capital. Key points:

- **§1(a)** engages RadialSpark on a "task by task basis" through individual Statements of Work — no requirements commitment, minimum volume, sole-source designation, or right of first refusal anywhere in the document.
- The only instances of "exclusive" are unrelated to exclusive dealing: **§4** (Contractor retains sole and exclusive ownership of its own pre-existing materials; grants Company a non-exclusive license) and **§7.17** (entire-agreement boilerplate).
- Targeted searches for sole-source, requirements, non-compete, "all of its", preferred provider, and minimum-commitment language returned nothing binding us.

This sits at the playbook's preferred position (no exclusivity obligation on Customer), so no changes are recommended.
